blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will be transported by motorcycle to Rio Tek, where the trekking ascent of Mount Roraima begins. The hike passes through gentle savannah hills, shallow rivers, and the indigenous settlement Parai Tepuy. Along the way, enjoy unforgettable views of Roraima Tepui and Kukenan Tepui.

The trek includes crossing the Rio Tek. During the rainy season (June–December), the river’s level is high and the current is strong, requiring a rope-assisted crossing. Continue hiking through the valley to the base of Roraima, where you will camp in tents in the lowland area, home to tropical birds and fireflies. Marvel at the quartz-covered cliffs of Roraima Tepui. Dinner and overnight in tents.

Meals: breakfast, lunch (packed), dinner

blocks.text:
Early morning after breakfast, continue along the only available diagonal route across the base of Mount Roraima. The narrow trail winds through mountain rainforests with small streams and rivers. Near the mountain base, the colorful vegetation transitions to shrubs, highland mosses, and ferns among rocks.

The trail leads to the “Two Tears” waterfall and then to the “living stones”, where careful attention is needed. Reach the summit of Roraima and continue toward the massive rock formations. Weather on the tepui summit is unpredictable, with sudden storms and heavy clouds possible at any time of year. Set up camp, have dinner, and celebrate reaching the top. Overnight in tents.

Meals: breakfast, lunch (packed), dinner
